title: USB Audio: Initial control transfers dissection support
description:
There is no need to use parsed class version from descriptor, simply use the interface protocol to determine USB Audio class version. Repurpose the audio class data to store Entity ID to type mapping. The mapping is necessary to determine control selectors that depend on entity type.

This MR handles dissection for all audio control requests found in USB Audio captures attached to #16305 (V1) and #15503 (V2).
